messages:
maria: Zenith Support opened a billing dispute: they were charged twice for a May promo adjustment. Invoice INV-2026-0510-300 attached.
owen: Paste invoice lines please.
maria: INV-2026-0510-300 shows PROMO-CREDIT (May) -$1,200.00 and PROMO-CREDIT (May) -$1,200.00 (duplicate). Customer requests a $1,200 reversal of the duplicate credit (i.e., refund the over-credit).
zenith-support: Confirmed on our side the account had one promo code, not two. We think a sync job applied the credit twice.
talia: If we over-credited the customer, we need to issue an invoice correction rather than a refund. But amount <$5k so manager approval ok. Need ENG task to fix promo-sync.
maria: Filing ENG-TASK-2026-992 to correct the sync and prevent reapply. Owen, do you have account owner approval to charge back?
owen: I spoke to the account owner; they prefer a negative adjustment on next invoice rather than immediate chargeback. They asked to reverse the extra credit by applying an offset on next billing.
talia: OK operationally we'll create a debit memo for $1,200 and include ledger note referencing ENG-TASK-2026-992. Commands:
``nbilling-tool debit-create --customer cust_ZX12 --amount 1200.00 --currency USD --reason "Reversal of duplicate promo credit" --invoice INV-2026-0510-300 --gl-code REV-ADJ
``
maria: Approve the debit memo approach. Please add audit note and confirm with customer once applied.
finance-bot: Ledger note created: debit_memo dm_72e4a queued. Automated policy check passed.
owen: Notifying customer and will confirm when offset posts. Thanks team.
